newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian gets 15 years for killing four children.
newsitem.headline: Russian gets 15 years for killing four children.

text.p: A Russian man was sentenced to 15 years in prison on Tuesday for killing four children with two grenades he used to hold up a kindergarten, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Yuri Kardanov, 30, entered the children's nursery in Vladikavkaz, capital of North Ossetia in the Caucasus in December 1995. He flourished the weapons and demanded a bus to take him to the city airport, the agency said.
Police managed to rescue most of the 55 children in the centre before Kardanov's two grenades exploded, Tass said.

"The supreme court of North Ossetia today sentenced a terrorist, by whose hand four pupils at the children's nursery number 44 in Vladikavkaz were killed in December 1995, to 15 years in prison," Tass said.
It said Kardanov had trapped eight children in a room and was behaving aggressively in negotiations with the police, holding the grenades with the pin out.
The report did not explain exactly how the grenades went off, but said the blasts killed four children and injured four other children, two policemen and two kindergarten staff.
Psychiatrists found Kardanov to be mentally normal, Itar-Tass added, giving no indication of his possible motive.

Armed hijacks and hostage takings have occurred at regular intervals in the volatile North Caucasus since the collapse of communism in 1991, which unleashed a wave of lawlessness and bloody conflict in the region on Russia's southern rim.
